keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title, skill, or other keywords to search for, such as `software engineer` or `Python developer`.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region, or country used by LinkedIn search, such as `New York, NY`, `Germany`, or `South Korea`.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Maximum number of unique job postings to save. The pay-per-event spending limit can reduce this number.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Only include jobs posted within the selected time range.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order LinkedIn search results by relevance or recency.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Optional employment-type filters. Leave empty to include every job type.

experienceLevels.title: Experience levels
experienceLevels.description: Optional seniority filters. Leave empty to include all experience levels.

workplaceTypes.title: Workplace types
workplaceTypes.description: Optional workplace filters for on-site, remote, and hybrid jobs.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Return only postings marked with LinkedIn Easy Apply.

includeDescription.title: Include full job descriptions
includeDescription.description: Fetch each public job page to include the description, applicant count, seniority, employment type, job function, and industry.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include description HTML
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Include the source description HTML alongside plain text. This only applies when full descriptions are enabled.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Public guest pages normally work from Apify data-center IPs; enable a proxy if LinkedIn rate-limits a larger run.
